description: 시흥도시공사_태양광발전설치현황정보조회서비스 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 시흥도시공사. S-ESG 친환경경영 기반 마련과 공공데이터 개방을 통한 민간사업 기회 제공 서비스 구축하여 공사 시설의 태양광발전 생산정보 관리체계를 마련. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 시흥도시공사. Its tags are 태양광, 에너지, ESG, 환경기상. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2022-03-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
